import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts import evaluate_local as evaluation
original = evaluation.preference_profile
def custom(hardware, power):
    return original(hardware, 'Custom', cpu=min(12,hardware['threads']), context=8192)
base = ROOT/'evaluation-results'/('custom-'+time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S'))
base.mkdir()
model = evaluation.LocalModel('qwen2.5-coder:7b')
digest = next((m.get('digest') for m in model.installed_models() if m.get('name')==model.model),None)
code = hashlib.sha256(b''.join(p.name.encode()+p.read_bytes() for p in sorted((ROOT/'local_agent').glob('*.py')))).hexdigest()
print('OUTPUT',base,flush=True)
with patch.object(evaluation,'preference_profile',custom):
    status = evaluation.evaluate_multifile(base,model,model.model,digest,code,suite='tags')
report = {'version':'1.10.0-preview','date':'2026-10-03','scope':'Guided trusted tag trials with Custom power: up to 12 threads and 8192 context. Not less-guided acceptance or a hard resource cap.',
          'harness_source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
          'harness_digest':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'results':json.loads((base/'results.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
(ROOT/'docs/evaluation-v1.10.0.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
raise SystemExit(status)
